factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table (I12) shows Q2 revenue of EUR 440,921 thousand (440.9m) vs EUR 504,512 thousand (504.5m) in Q2 2025 (12.6% decrease). Gross profit was EUR 59,397 thousand (59.4m) vs EUR 55,668 thousand (55.7m).

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA rose 11.8% to EUR 64.2 million, operating profit increased 9.8% to EUR 29.7 million, and net profit reached EUR 1.9 million compared with EUR 0.2 million in Q2 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table (I12) shows Q2 EBITDA of EUR 64,158 thousand (64.2m) vs EUR 57,390 thousand (57.4m) in Q2 2025 (11.8% increase). Operating profit was EUR 29,686 thousand (29.7m) vs EUR 27,038 thousand (27.0m) (9.8% increase). Net profit was EUR 1,883 thousand (1.9m) vs EUR 150 thousand (0.2m).

factual_claims.claim: The improvement reflected stronger performance across all segments, particularly supporting businesses, which moved from a EUR 4.4 million EBITDA loss in the first half of 2025 to EUR 5.6 million of EBITDA in 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO (I6) explicitly states: 'the most significant turnaround came from our supporting businesses, where EBITDA improved from a loss of €4.4 million to a profit of €5.6 million.' Segment reporting table (I23) confirms supporting segments' EBITDA was -EUR 4,423 thousand in H1 2025 vs +EUR 5,598 thousand in H1 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Energy EBITDA increased to EUR 59.9 million from EUR 51.7 million, while maritime transport EBITDA rose to EUR 39.3 million from EUR 33.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment reporting table (I23) shows Energy EBITDA of EUR 59,891 thousand (59.9m) in H1 2026 vs EUR 51,749 thousand (51.7m) in H1 2025. Maritime transport EBITDA was EUR 39,277 thousand (39.3m) vs EUR 33,292 thousand (33.3m).

factual_claims.claim: Real estate EBITDA increased to EUR 6.5 million from EUR 4.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment reporting table (I23) shows Real Estate EBITDA of EUR 6,462 thousand (6.5m) in H1 2026 vs EUR 4,433 thousand (4.4m) in H1 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Energy revenue declined as Elenger’s gas and electricity sales volumes fell 34% to 3.3 TWh, mainly because of lower wholesale sales.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026 (I8) states: 'Elenger Group’s gas and electricity sales volumes in the second quarter decreased by 34%, compared to a year earlier, totalling 3.3 TWh (compared to 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025). The decline was primarily driven by a reduction in wholesale sales.'

factual_claims.claim: Regional gas consumption decreased 7% to 7.0 TWh.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Energy business segment (I8) states: 'natural gas consumption in the Finnish-Baltic region totalled 7.0 TWh, decreasing by 7% compared with the previous year (7.6 TWh).'

factual_claims.claim: Results in maritime transport were affected by weaker demand, higher fuel prices, increased EU ETS emissions costs and geopolitical volatility.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026 (I7) lists these exact factors: 'Heightened geopolitical tensions... increased volatility in global energy markets... fuel costs... demand has remained weak... EU ETS increased to 100% of the emitted CO2 equivalent.'

factual_claims.claim: Tallink carried 1.45 million passengers in Q2, down 2.2% year on year, while cargo units increased 2.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026 (I7) states: 'Tallink Grupp and its subsidiaries carried 1,454,725 passengers, representing a 2.2% decrease year-on-year... cargo units transported increased by 2.9% to 68,986.'

factual_claims.claim: Fuel costs rose by EUR 8.4 million, and Tallink’s EBITDA declined to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026 (I7) states: 'Higher fuel prices increased fuel costs by EUR 8.4 million compared to the same period last year... Tallink generated EBITDA of EUR 34.3 million compared to EUR 37.4 million a year ago.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to EUR 2.71 billion from EUR 2.60 billion at year-end, while equity rose to EUR 1.20 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table (I12) shows total assets of EUR 2,714,309 thousand (2.71B) as at 30.06.26 vs EUR 2,596,607 thousand (2.60B) as at 31.12.25. Total equity was EUR 1,200,533 thousand (1.20B) vs EUR 1,175,404 thousand (1.18B).

factual_claims.claim: Cash increased to EUR 253.2 million, and net debt declined to EUR 829.9 million from EUR 851.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table (I12) shows cash and cash equivalents of EUR 253,187 thousand (253.2M) as at 30.06.26 vs EUR 146,368 thousand (146.4M) as at 31.12.25. Net debt was EUR 829,904 thousand (829.9M) vs EUR 851,582 thousand (851.6M).

factual_claims.claim: The Group invested approximately EUR 50 million during the first half.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (I6) states: 'Investments: approximately EUR 50 million.' This is further broken down in the Cash Flow Statement (I19) where investing activities used EUR 45.4 million cash.

factual_claims.claim: Infortar increased its Tallink ownership to 68.76%, and no business combinations were completed in Q2.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Changes in Q2 2026 section (I8) states: 'Infortar acquired additional shares in Tallink Grupp, as a result of which its ownership in Tallink Group increased to 68.76%.' Note 6.2 states: 'No business combinations in Q2 2026.'
